scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The discovery club
scenes.caption: Meera asks a pretend assistant to draft a note about the club garden. It writes smoothly that the club planted twenty seeds. The teacher’s source card records twelve seeds, so Kabir checks the number before copying the answer into the magazine.
scenes.speech: Meera asks a pretend assistant to draft a note about the club garden. It writes smoothly that the club planted twenty seeds. The teacher’s source card records twelve seeds, so Kabir checks the number before copying the answer into the magazine.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A problem to solve
scenes.caption: A language tool can produce convincing sentences without checking the club’s real record. Confidence, length and polite wording are not supporting evidence. The team separates each claim from the source that could support it, instead of trusting the paragraph as a single block.
scenes.speech: A language tool can produce convincing sentences without checking the club’s real record. Confidence, length and polite wording are not supporting evidence. The team separates each claim from the source that could support it, instead of trusting the paragraph as a single block.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Try the idea
scenes.caption: The source card supports twelve planted seeds, not a claim that every seed will grow. The students keep the supported fact, remove the invented guarantee and acknowledge that a tool helped draft the note. All examples are offline; no live assistant account is needed.
scenes.speech: The source card supports twelve planted seeds, not a claim that every seed will grow. The students keep the supported fact, remove the invented guarantee and acknowledge that a tool helped draft the note. All examples are offline; no live assistant account is needed.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose and explain
scenes.caption: Assistant draft says twenty seeds. Supplied checked garden record says twelve. There is no second record supporting twenty. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.speech: Assistant draft says twenty seeds. Supplied checked garden record says twelve. There is no second record supporting twenty. Compare the actions, then inspect the explanation before moving on.
scenes.dialogue: What number should the note report?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: See the consequence
scenes.caption: Use twelve from the supplied checked record and explain the correction. The assistant’s fluent wording does not outweigh the evidence for this fictional garden.
scenes.speech: Use twelve from the supplied checked record and explain the correction. The assistant’s fluent wording does not outweigh the evidence for this fictional garden.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Your turn in the lab
scenes.caption: Now open the practice lab. Work through claims and evidence, then source checking, then a corrected answer. Test each answer, read feedback and try again when needed. Save your evidence and explain one decision in your own words.
